name: trstctl native connector high-fidelity emulator contract

entries.connector.registry: authenticated A10 login, certificate upload, key upload, client-SSL bind, readback
entries.connector.nginx: atomic certificate/key files, config-test process, reload process, readback
entries.connector.apache: atomic certificate/key files, config-test process, graceful reload process, readback
entries.connector.caddy: atomic watched files, reload process, readback
entries.connector.envoy: SDS GET followed by PUT of a v3 TLS Secret and readback
entries.connector.iis: PFX staging, PowerShell import, HTTP.SYS rebind, process transcript
entries.connector.haproxy: combined PEM write, configuration validation, reload, readback
entries.connector.f5: authenticated iControl uploads, crypto installs, Client SSL profile bind, readback
entries.connector.netscaler: NITRO login, file uploads, sslcertkey update, logout, readback
entries.connector.a10: AXAPI login, certificate/key uploads, client-SSL template bind, readback
entries.connector.kemp: authenticated upload to an immutable dod-target-trstctl-<12 lowercase hex fingerprint> object, exact virtual-service bind, readback
entries.connector.fortigate: authenticated FortiOS local-certificate upsert and readback
entries.connector.paloalto: authenticated PAN-OS certificate and private-key imports and readback
entries.connector.postfix: atomic Postfix/Dovecot files, both validations and reloads, readback
entries.connector.traefik: atomic watched certificate/key files and readback
entries.connector.acm: canonical SigV4-verified ACM ImportCertificate and readback
entries.connector.azurekv: bearer-authenticated Key Vault certificate import and readback
entries.connector.gcpcm: bearer-authenticated Certificate Manager patch plus operation poll and readback
entries.connector.javakeystore: atomic PKCS12/JKS write plus independent file readback
entries.connector.postgresql: atomic TLS files, PostgreSQL reload process, readback
entries.connector.mysql: atomic TLS files, MySQL reload process, readback
entries.connector.rabbitmq: atomic TLS files, RabbitMQ rotation process, readback
entries.connector.elasticsearch: atomic watched TLS files and readback
entries.connector.tomcat: atomic TLS files, Tomcat reload process, readback

security.authentication: native connector authentication is exact: Basic, bearer, A10/NITRO sessions, or PAN-OS keys must match the configured credential; ACM recomputes the credential-, region-, service-, header-, and payload-bound SigV4 signature
security.user_path: served target CRUD + effect-free target-vantage preview + identity bind + target deploy route; production preview and issuance create outbox-owned connector.test and sealed connector.deploy commands
security.preview: every row must return one terminal dry_run_planned receipt before deploy; the out-of-process receiver hashes all mutable certificate/readback/file state before and after preview and requires the digests to match
security.completion: passed is true only after the entry-specific mutation sequence, exact validation/reload argv in order, and readback from the connector-specific installed credential path
security.failure_diagnostic: a failed substrate emits only bounded entry ID, parsed method/path pairs, readback presence, signal count, and signal-error state; request headers, bodies, credentials, certificates, and raw signal arguments are excluded
